_comment: Legend for the flat fill colours painted on sources/old_world_regions.png —
what each colour block represents. Authored so the source painting can be
edited (e.g. removing stray splotches) without losing track of which colour is
This MIRRORS the authoritative map in mapgen/generate_state_labels.py
(OLD_WORLD_MACROS) — that Python tuple is the single source of truth the
pipeline classifies against by EXACT RGB equality (worldgen.scope.classify_fills),
so a fill must match one of these RGBs to the byte or it is treated as bare
parchment / out of scope. Keep this file in step with OLD_WORLD_MACROS; it is a
human reference, not read by any generator.
'border' is the magenta province/state subdivision network, not a fill: it
isolates the drawn cells inside each macro and is classified separately

fills.name: norsca
fills.represents: Norsca — the northern, Chaos-touched peninsula. A separate macro from Kislev.

fills.name: kislev
fills.represents: Kislev — the northern realm of men. A separate macro from Norsca.

fills.name: athel_loren
fills.represents: Athel Loren — the wood-elf forest realm. Its own macro.

fills.name: southern_realms
fills.represents: The Southern Realms — spans Estalia + Tilea + the Border Princes.

fills.name: badlands
fills.represents: The Badlands proper only (the dwarf holds / World's Edge Mountains are the indigo fill).

fills.name: dwarf_holds
fills.represents: The Dwarf Holds / World's Edge Mountains (Karaz Ankor).

fills.name: nehekhara
fills.represents: Nehekhara — the Land of the Dead.

border.name: province_border_network
border.represents: Magenta province/state subdivision border network — NOT a fill. Drawn inside the macro blocks to divide them into individual provinces/states; pure magenta is absent from the parchment art so it isolates cleanly.
